# Mises Institute

> > The Mises Institute promotes Austrian economics, free markets, and libertarian political philosophy through analysis of monetary policy, government intervention, and individual liberty.

Founded to advance the scholarship of Ludwig von Mises and the Austrian School, the Institute publishes commentary on Federal Reserve policy, central banking, government spending, and political economy. Contributors include scholars and analysts examining contemporary issues through the lens of Austrian economics and classical liberalism.

## Key Topics

- Austrian Economics
- Federal Reserve Criticism
- Monetary Policy
- Central Banking
- COVID-19 Lockdowns
- Government Spending
- Libertarian Political Philosophy
- Murray Rothbard
- Free Markets
- Totalitarianism
- Classical Liberalism
- Inflation
- Pandemic Policy
- Corporate Socialism
- Individual Liberty

## Monetary Policy and Federal Reserve Analysis

- [A Problem with the Fed's Dual Mandate](https://mises.org/power-market/problem-feds-dual-mandate): Aro critiques Fed's dual mandate and employment-driven monetary expansion
- [How the Fed's Inflation Is Driving Stock Buybacks](https://mises.org/mises-wire/how-feds-inflation-driving-stock-buybacks): Analysis of how Fed monetary inflation incentivizes corporate stock buybacks
- [The Bank of Japan: An Economic Cautionary Tale](https://mises.org/power-market/bank-japan-economic-cautionary-tale): BOJ's stock market intervention and QE as warning for central banking
- [Bulls, Bears, and Beyond: In Depth with James Grant](https://mises.org/austrian/bulls-bears-and-beyond-depth-james-grant-0): Duffy interviews James Grant on Fed policy and Austrian business cycles
- [The "Miracle Recovery" Narrative: We'll Just Print Our Way to Prosperity](https://mises.org/mises-wire/miracle-recovery-narrative-well-just-print-our-way-prosperity): Grass critiques European lockdowns and ECB money-printing recovery claims

## COVID-19 Pandemic Policy and Lockdowns

- [An Interview with Vaclav Klaus on Europe's Lockdowns](https://mises.org/power-market/interview-vaclav-klaus-europes-lockdowns): Grass interviews Czech ex-PM Klaus on COVID-19 lockdowns and freedom
- [Not Even Gretchen Whitmer Wants More of the CDC's Lockdowns](https://mises.org/mises-wire/not-even-gretchen-whitmer-wants-more-cdcs-lockdowns): McMaken on shifting political climate against lockdowns in Michigan
- [In Some Countries, Lockdowns May Be the "New Normal"](https://mises.org/mises-wire/some-countries-lockdowns-may-be-new-normal): Examines Ireland's persistent lockdowns vs. European pandemic policy shifts

## Government Spending and Economic Policy

- [Why a Green New Deal Is More Expensive Than Joe Biden Realizes](https://mises.org/mises-wire/why-green-new-deal-more-expensive-joe-biden-realizes): Deist analyzes hidden costs and net energy issues in Green New Deal policy
- [Schumer to America: Help Is on the Way!](https://mises.org/power-market/schumer-america-help-way): Aro critiques Schumer's American Rescue Plan and stimulus spending rhetoric
- [We Cannot Build an Economy on Lies](https://mises.org/mises-wire/we-cannot-build-economy-lies): Anderson debunks media myth of free-market orthodoxy dominating America
- [The Left Understands Taxation Is Theft, That's Why They Support It](https://mises.org/power-market/left-understands-taxation-theft-thats-why-they-support-it): Critique of MMT's Kelton and leftist views on taxation as punishment tool

## Political Philosophy and Libertarian Thought

- [Fighting Totalitarianism: Rothbard versus Monasticism](https://mises.org/mises-wire/fighting-totalitarianism-rothbard-versus-monasticism): Rectenwald argues against monasticism in confronting modern fascism
- [An American Classical Liberalism](https://mises.org/mises-wire/american-classical-liberalism): Rockwell on limited government and federalism in American political tradition
- [The Straussian Labyrinth](https://mises.org/friday-philosophy/straussian-labyrinth): Rothbard critiques Leo Strauss on natural law vs. natural rights debate

## Markets and Corporate Analysis

- [The GameStop Saga Unravels Stakeholder Theory](https://mises.org/mises-wire/gamestop-saga-unravels-stakeholder-theory): Deist uses GameStop to expose contradictions in stakeholder capitalism
- [Deregulate the Policing Market](https://mises.org/power-market/deregulate-policing-market): McDermott advocates private policing solutions amid UK crime rate failures

## Optional

- [The Socialists Who Supported Free Trade](https://mises.org/power-market/socialists-who-supported-free-trade): Matthews reviews Palen's article on Marx and socialist free-trade tradition
- [Decentralization, Absolutism, and the Papal States](https://mises.org/power-market/decentralization-absolutism-and-papal-states): Book review of Kertzer's work on Papal States and 19th-century Europe
- [The NBA's National Anthem Mandate: Another Political Ploy from Pro Sports](https://mises.org/power-market/nbas-national-anthem-mandate-another-political-ploy-pro-sports): Analysis of NBA anthem mandate and Mark Cuban controversy as political ritual
